title_zh: 请舞蹈教练单独示范转向

scenario.label_zh: 澄清初学舞蹈动作并获得反馈
scenario.goal_zh: 弄清第一组舞步的顺序并请教练单独示范转向

context_zh: 初学者练习一组舞步时混淆后退与转身，向教练请求慢速示范。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Do I step backwards before the turn or after it?

sentences.speaker: Dance teacher
sentences.text: Before it. Move your right foot back, then turn to face the window.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: I keep falling to one side. How do I balance on that foot?

sentences.speaker: Dance teacher
sentences.text: Do not lock your knee. Bend it a little and make the step smaller.

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: That feels steadier, but I still lose track of which way to turn when the music starts.

sentences.speaker: Dance teacher
sentences.text: Shall I show you the turn on its own, without the other steps?

sentences.speaker: Paula
sentences.text: Yes, please. I will watch once and then copy you.

sentences.speaker: Dance teacher
sentences.text: All right. Face the mirror with me, and we will take it slowly.
